clips.title: The story
paras: Nugget slugs are specialized 17.5-gauge mechanical fasteners used in industrial engineering. Stockpiled in tool buckets by the Venture Company at the Sludge Fen, they are coveted by tinkerers attempting to repair volatile machinery.

Nugget slugs are heavy-duty metallic fasteners manufactured for demanding industrial assemblies. Specifically sized at 17.5 gauge, these components are an essential part of the heavy equipment deployed across Venture Company extraction sites. While useless as ordinary trade goods, they are indispensable to tinkerers dealing with customized goblin hardware.
